title: Fixed Hexagonal Resonator and Two String Spike Fiddle
description: One newly authored whole unbowed two-string spike-fiddle-style static exterior: a short hollow hexagonal timber resonator with real open rear and thin complete front membrane, a continuous round rod passing through the body and extending into a long fingerboard-free neck, two large lateral tuning pegs, two separate supported strings, a small bridge, upper binding and lower tail attachment. The open-back hexagonal tube and through-rod topology differs from a carved waisted violin with fingerboard and four-peg box, and from a circular banjo pot with broad fretted neck and five strings. Newly authored geometry, no extracted kit parts. Four opaque PBR roles, metres, Z up, horizontal-envelope-centred, laid on its finite rear hexagonal rim. One whole model, zero scenes. No bow included; no rigging, tuning, string tension, acoustic operation, historical authenticity, manufacture, protective or safety claim. Fixed illustrative display only.
